nodes.name: Harrowmouth
nodes.description: A weathered river-mouth town on the frontier's edge — the party's home base and the starting point of the campaign.

nodes.name: The Salt Widow's Lantern
nodes.description: A bleached driftwood post driven into a sea-stack at the tide-line, hung with a iron cage lantern whose wick burns rendered shark liver rather than tallow — the smell carries half a mile. Fisherfolk say a woman named Dara Cael has tended it every dusk for thirty years without explanation, and no ship has grounded on these rocks since she started.

nodes.name: The Saltblind Lantern
nodes.description: A collapsed lighthouse whose iron lens-housing still tilts seaward atop cracked basalt columns, refracting moonlight into a wandering ghost-beam that sailors swear predicts squalls by turning green. The keeper's cottage below is long drowned, but her tide-chart, etched into the rock face in copper nail-heads, remains legible at low water.

nodes.name: The Tidal Lantern
nodes.description: A collapsed signal tower perched on a chalk headland, its bronze mirror-array still faintly intact — salvagers learned the hard way that tilting the reflector at the wrong angle ignites the dry grass in a fifty-foot arc. Local fishers use the glare as a bearing mark without knowing why the hill never grows back its scrub.

nodes.name: The Tidekeeper's Battery
nodes.description: A crumbling coastal artillery emplacement whose four bronze cannon barrels have been colonised by nesting gannets, the birds' white-streaked heads peering from the muzzles like charges on a mad heraldic device. The powder magazine floods to knee-depth at every high tide, and the iron door has not closed properly since a kraken — or something close to one — bent it outward three winters past.

nodes.name: The Salt Ledgers
nodes.description: A terraced limestone outcrop where Akkar merchants once carved trade tallies directly into the cliff face — hundreds of columns of wedge-cut numerals in a script no living scholar reads, still sharp despite the salt wind. Goats shelter in the carved recesses at dusk, their hooves clicking against forgotten fortunes.

nodes.name: Thresh Point
nodes.description: A squat basalt tower barnacled to its arrow slits, occupied by a cartographer who trades accurate coastal charts for teeth — she claims each extracted molar maps what its owner witnessed at sea, and her collection numbers in the thousands.
